source.edition: Samacheer Kalvi new-syllabus edition (first introduced 2018-19), reprinted for 2026-27; exact imprint/reprint line not verified

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/tn-g06.json. 16 of 16 chapter titles could not be checked against an official source (marked sourceVerified: false). Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://www.textbooksonline.tn.nic.in/ https://tnschools.gov.in/ https://www.shaalaa.com/textbook-solutions/tamil-nadu-board-samacheer-kalvi-solutions-class-6th-mathematics-term-1-answers-guide_317 https://www.shaalaa.com/textbook-solutions/samacheer-kalvi-solutions-mathematics-term-2-english-class-6-tn-board_318. Notes: Official sources could not be opened: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and e-learn.tnschools.gov.in refuse automated fetching via robots.txt, tnschools.gov.in and scert.tnschools.gov.in are JavaScript apps that returned no content, and the sandbox shell has no internet access. Because of this every chapter is marked verified:false. Chapter titles were cross-checked between two independent secondary sites (Shaalaa and Brainkart), which agree on every chapter title and order. Neither is official. Edition currency for 2026-27: DT Next (8 May 2026; 16 Aug 2026) reports that only Classes 1-3 received new-syllabus books in 2026-27. Classes 4-12 continue on the existing Samacheer Kalvi syllabus (the 2018-19 / 2019-20 'new syllabus' books), and the new State Education Policy curriculum is targeted for 2027-28. The same article says Classes 4-12 books with the old syllabus were 'being prepared' for 2026-27, so a 2026 reprint or re-typeset printing may exist. I could not see its imprint page to confirm the edition line or any content changes. Section titles come from Brainkart's topic index for this book, which follows the textbook's headings. They were not checked against the official PDF. I dropped exercise, summary, 'Try these' and worked-example entries and kept only content headings. Section
